card.question: For each DS1 gold, how much legally obtainable full text predates it, how must it be blocked, how are memorisation probes run, and which models have documented cutoffs?
card.answer: Free-to-read pre-gold works per domain query range from 4 (Phillips 1998) to 5,457 (Canopy ERCP); 3 of 17 provisional golds fall below a proposed screen of 100. Only Russ-Jara and Ede postdate a documented cutoff, Mistral Small 3's system-prompt date of 2023-10-01.
card.changed: I10 gets a screen, a floor and a stricter blocklist: same-team precursors move 5 golds' cut-offs earlier, and citing works are blocked whatever their date. Probes are calibrated on decoys and on OLMo 2's public data. The TDM route is guaranteed only with institutional access.

worked: 14 of 17 provisional golds pass the screen of 100, with 263 to 5,457 free pre-gold works each.
failed: Date-only cut-off leaks: 5 of 17 golds have same-team precursors, and 3 of 17 have citing works dated on or before the cut-off.
